2. 放到哪里、怎么导入: 2. Where to put it and how to import
打开「资料」页，点击「添加资料」（或在「创建题组」里点击「添加资料」），选好课程: Open the Sources page and click Add source (or click Add source inside Create deck). Pick the course, then drop the converted file on the Files tab or click Choose files; plain text can also be saved via the Paste text tab. In Study Mode in the main chat, you can also place the file in studyhub-work/ or a local folder and ask the assistant to import it.
Basic converters often drop formulas or turn them into images. Enable LaTeX formula output in the external tool and export as .md or .tex (preserving $...$ / $$...$$) instead of plain text.
若导出的仍是图片型 PDF 或只含图片链接的 Markdown，StudyHub: If the output is still an image-only PDF or Markdown with only image links, StudyHub cannot extract body text (standalone image lines in .md are skipped). Turn on OCR in the external tool and export text or structured JSON.
StudyHub 要求文本与 JSON 文件为 UTF-8 编码；GBK、GB1: StudyHub requires UTF-8 encoding for text and JSON files; GBK, GB18030, or UTF-16 will fail with an encoding error or garbled text. Re-save the file as UTF-8 in an editor (such as VS Code or Notepad) and import again.
